llm.summary: The skill provides a customs-risk checklist without requesting sensitive access or automated actions.

dimensions.detail: No local data collection, credential access, uploads, or business-record changes are requested. Publisher links provide promotional and metadata references.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains only Markdown, with no installer, executable code, or dependency installation instructions.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions remain within customs analysis but reference a parent thinking method that is not bundled.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No background workers, persistent changes, elevated permissions, or automatic updates are requested.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: Tariff, product-origin, and duty-exposure checks fit the stated customs-screening purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Use this as a screening checklist. Confirm current tariff rules and order-specific scope with authoritative sources and qualified counsel before making import decisions.
